title: Page 4
content_zh:
忽而水池里泛起了涟漪，原来是她的泪水滴在水池里，泛起的涟漪一圈又一圈向外扩散而去。
她好难过，真的好难过，这种被否定的感觉真的让她好难过，连带也让她一直以来的信念都崩溃了。
她一直以为，只要她够努力，就能够让大家忘记她外表的缺点，接受她，可是没想到，她的外表还是一道她无法跨越的阻碍。
那这些年她这么努力的学音乐，到底是在做什么？不就一点意义也没有了吗？
“呜呜……”
“池子里的水已经够多了，不差你那几滴眼泪。”
同一个地点，同样的男声传来，沈明慧抬起头，在昏暗的光线中看见了那个男生。是赵廷汉……
他还是一派轻松的模样，坐在她身旁的石礅上，脸上净是惬意的表情，手却从口袋里抽出卫生纸递给她。
接过，“谢谢……”努力把眼泪擦掉，努力收拾自己的难过情绪，虽然很难，但是各种嘲讽与羞辱，她也不是第一次碰到了，最多，哭哭就好了。
“想要分享一下是怎么回事吗？”
沈明慧坐在一旁擦着眼泪，就算讲，也无济于事，可是不知怎的，在他的陪伴下，她竟然有一股冲动，想要把心里的话说出来。
事后想想，她自己也弄不清楚，或许是太伤心了，更或许是因为别的原因，让她选择说出自己的伤心跟难过，跟眼前这个只有一面之缘，还算陌生的男生分享。
第1章(2)
“我是音乐班的，最近学校要组管弦乐团，老师要选首席，我本来以为我有机会，不过我显然是太有自信了……老师最后不是选我……”
“那是选谁？”
“一个比我高、比我瘦，比我漂亮的女生……”又想哭了，“单是比我瘦就赢我了啦……”
赵廷汉笑了笑，“老师有说是因为这个原因吗？”
委屈的看了他一眼，点头，“老师说，这样的选择对学校比较好，因为我站在台上确实不好看，就算琴艺再好也没用……”
赵廷汉沉默一会儿，嘴里喃喃念着；沈明慧听到了，好像是在骂人，可是赵廷汉没有将话清楚说出来。
过了许久，他才开口，“只有首席才可以拉琴吗？”

“什么意思？”
“我是说，没有选上首席，就不可以继续拉小提琴了吗？”
用力摇头，“当然不是啊！”这样还得了？
赵廷汉轻松的向后一靠，一阵风就这么吹过来，穿梭在两人之间，气氛轻松惬意，他们就好像认识很久的朋友一样，竟然可以这样自然的相处。
“既然这样，其实你也没什么损失，你还是可以继续玩音乐，继续待在乐团里……除非你玩音乐就是为了要当上首席。”
“我……”
他的一番话竟然让她哑口无言，老天！她也真是的，竟然将有没有当上首席看得比音乐本身还重要。
他说得没错，她弄错方向了，能不能透过玩音乐让自己快乐，这才是最重要的啊！
没想到竟然是由他来劝自己，这样的赵廷汉真是让她不敢相信，三言两语，轻轻松松就开导了她。
“我……我真不敢相信耶！你竟然这么会说话。”看着他，像是想将眼前这个男生看清楚。
赵廷汉也看着这个胖胖的女孩，或者说，就这样让她打量着自己。
“其实你应该不坏啊！干嘛要这样常常打架闹事？当流氓很好玩吗？”她没有恶意，只是问着，带着一丝丝关心的语气。
他耸耸肩，“大家都期待我当个流氓，我只是顺从大家的期望而已。如果有一天，我变乖了，说不定大家还不习惯。”
沈明慧眼睛一亮，“我也是这样安慰自己耶！说不定大家已经习惯我胖的样子了，如果有一天，我瘦下来，说不定大家还不习惯呢！”
赵廷汉脸部微微，不知该笑还是该哭──他不知道该称赞这女孩的乐观向上，还是该提醒她，别太过乐观了。
此时沈明慧脸上满是笑容，很灿烂，方才那哭泣的阴霾已经完全消失，她笑着，话语里有着自我解嘲，说她自己好胖，胖到把别人的空气都吸光了，但话里也有着对他的提醒，要他别再鬼混，别打架闹事，要好好念书，别逃课，拉拉杂杂说了一堆。
这些话，以前他从学校老师，还有管区警察那里听多了，听得很烦；可是现在听她说，竟然一点烦的感觉都没有。
甚至他还觉得她的笑容很亮眼，在这个傍晚的校园角落里，成为吸引他目光的唯一焦点。
怪！他怎么会这样一直盯着这个胖妹。
真是怪了……

第二次见面，场面依旧很温馨热络，两人就像是一般老朋友一样聊着天，他出乎她的意料，谈吐竟是如此稳重成熟，跟那天在训育组长面前桀骜不驯的模样大相径庭。
而她也出乎赵廷汉的意料之外，本以为这种聪明的好学生，一定说话很老成，没想到她竟然像个小女孩一样，叽叽喳喳说着不停，有时候还会说一些让人啼笑皆非的话。
从那天之后，他们常常在中庭巧遇，傍晚六点多，音乐班的休息时间，大家都会休息一下，为七点开始练习做准备。
沈明慧就利用这个时间到中庭来，表面上是跟赵廷汉巧遇，实际上，两人心里有数，这个时间点在这里就是要遇见对方。
就这样，两人愈来愈熟稔，谈天的内容也愈来愈深入，聊到彼此的心情，聊到彼此的出身。
他知道她出身显赫，可是其实她压力很大，她的外表早就让她的父母失望到绝望了，现在的她，只能靠功课与音乐表现来满足父母。
而她也知道，他是庶出之子，被父亲的正室赶出家门，现在靠着自己打工养活自己，母亲死后，他独自一个人，自由自在乐逍遥。
但是他知道，她心里渴望瘦下来，渴望摆脱现在的模样，成为一个正常的人，现在的她，只能活在别人的眼光下。
而她也知道，他其实很孤单，每天闲晃，认识了一大堆“小弟”、“手下”，他却依旧孤单。
那天在中庭，沈明慧跟他分享着团练的甘苦谈，说着说着，她对他提议，下周乐团在学校里面举办小型演奏会，要他来参加，帮忙增加人气。
“学校不会希望我参加的。”
“怎么会？你就乖乖的坐在那边听就好了啊！”
“就算我乖乖的坐在那边，学校也不会认为我是乖乖的。”
“可是……你不是跟我说，不要在乎别人怎么看，做好自己就好了吗？”
赵廷汉沉默了，想了想，发现自己竟然被自己的话给套住，无法找到辩解之词。最后，他只好答应她。
更重要的是，他发现自己根本无法拒绝她──拒绝这个在这所学校里面唯一一个不把他当坏蛋，有勇气跟他说话的女生所提出的要求。
时间飞速流逝，终于来到了下周，学校的礼堂改装成音乐会表演场地。今晚的表演，沈明慧将有一段独奏，或许是因为老师没有将她选为首席，心里觉得过意不去，特别给她这个机会。
虽然有很多团员不满，这些团员虽然不甘愿的承认，沈明慧的琴艺是团里面程度最好的，可是要她们接受这个胖妹有上台独奏的机会，这就是让她们感到很不爽，尤其是那些自认为外表比沈明慧好看一千倍、一万倍的女生。
这些沈明慧都不管，她得到这个机会可以上台演奏给大家听，她高兴都来不及了，哪有时间去管别人怎么样。
content_en:
Suddenly ripples appeared in the pool. It turned out to be her tears dripping into the pool, and the ripples spread outward in circles.
She was so sad, really sad. This feeling of being denied really made her sad, and it also caused her long-standing belief to collapse.
She always thought that as long as she worked hard enough, she could make everyone forget the shortcomings of her appearance and accept her. However, she did not expect that her appearance was still an obstacle that she could not overcome.
So what on earth has she been doing after working so hard to learn music all these years? Doesn’t it mean nothing at all?
"Woooo..."
"There is enough water in the pool, and it doesn't need a few of your tears."
The same male voice came from the same place. Shen Minghui raised her head and saw the boy in the dim light. It's Zhao Tinghan...
He still looked relaxed, sitting on the stone bed next to her, with a contented expression on his face, but he took the toilet paper out of his pocket and handed it to her.
She took it and said, "Thank you..." She tried her best to wipe away her tears and try to deal with her sadness. Although it was difficult, it was not the first time she encountered all kinds of ridicule and humiliation. At most, she could just cry.
“Want to share what’s going on?”
Shen Minghui sat aside and wiped her tears. Even if she talked, it would be of no use. But somehow, in his company, she actually had the urge to say what was in her heart.
Thinking about it afterwards, she couldn't figure it out. Maybe she was too sad, or maybe it was because of other reasons that made her choose to express her sadness and sorrow and share it with the boy in front of her who had only met her once and was still a stranger.
Chapter 1(2)
"I'm in the music class. Recently, the school was organizing an orchestra, and the teacher wanted to choose the lead singer. I originally thought I had a chance, but I was obviously too confident...the teacher didn't choose me in the end..."
"Who are you choosing?"
"A girl who is taller, thinner, and prettier than me..." I want to cry again, "She can beat me just because she is thinner..."
Zhao Tinghan smiled and said, "Did the teacher say it was because of this?"
She glanced at him aggrievedly and nodded, "The teacher said that this choice is better for the school, because I really don't look good standing on the stage, and it doesn't matter how good my piano skills are..."
Zhao Tinghan was silent for a while, muttering in his mouth; Shen Minghui heard it and seemed to be cursing, but Zhao Tinghan did not say the words clearly.
After a long time, he finally asked, "Can only the chief performer play the piano?"
"What do you mean?"
"I mean, if you don't choose the concertmaster, you can't continue playing the violin?"
Shaking his head vigorously, "Of course not!" Is this okay?
Zhao Tinghan leaned back easily, and a gust of wind blew between them. The atmosphere was relaxed and comfortable. They were like friends who had known each other for a long time, and they could get along so naturally.
"In this case, you actually have nothing to lose. You can still continue to play music and stay in the orchestra...unless you play music just to become the concertmaster."
"I..."
His words actually made her speechless, God! She really puts whether she becomes the first singer more important than the music itself.
He was right. She had gone in the wrong direction. Whether she could make herself happy by playing music was the most important thing!
She didn't expect that he would be the one to persuade her. She couldn't believe that Zhao Tinghan was like this. He persuaded her easily with just a few words.
"I...I can't believe it! You are so good at talking." She looked at him as if she wanted to see the boy in front of her clearly.
Zhao Tinghan also looked at this fat girl, or let her look at him like this.
"Actually, you shouldn't be bad! Why do you have to fight and make trouble so often? Is it fun to be a gangster?" She didn't mean anything, she just asked, with a hint of concern in her tone..
He shrugged, "Everyone expects me to be a gangster, and I just obey everyone's expectations. If one day I become good, maybe everyone won't get used to it."
Shen Minghui's eyes lit up, "That's how I comfort myself! Maybe everyone is used to me being fat. If one day I lose weight, maybe everyone won't be used to it yet!"
Zhao Tinghan's face was slightly confused, not knowing whether to laugh or cry - he didn't know whether to praise the girl for her optimism or to remind her not to be too optimistic.
At this time, Shen Minghui's face was full of smiles, very bright, and the haze of crying just now had completely disappeared. She smiled, and there was self-mockery in her words, saying that she was so fat, so fat that she sucked all the air out of other people, but there was also a reminder to him in her words, asking him to stop fooling around, stop fighting and making trouble, study hard, and don't skip classes. She talked a lot.
He had heard these words many times from school teachers and district police before, and they were very annoying; but now when he heard her say them, he didn't feel annoyed at all.
He even thought her smile was very bright, and it became the only focus that attracted his attention in this corner of the campus in the evening.
Strange! How could he keep staring at this fat girl like this?
It's really weird...
When they met for the second time, the scene was still very warm and warm. The two of them chatted like ordinary old friends. He surprised her by being so steady and mature in his conversation, which was very different from the unruly demeanor in front of the training team leader that day.
And she was beyond Zhao Tinghan's expectation. He thought that such a smart and good student must be very mature in speaking, but he didn't expect that she turned out to be like a little girl, chattering non-stop, and sometimes said some ridiculous things.
From that day on, they often met by chance in the atrium. At around six o'clock in the evening, during the break time of the music class, everyone would take a break to prepare for practice starting at seven o'clock.
Shen Minghui took advantage of this time to come to the atrium. On the surface, she met Zhao Tinghan by chance. In fact, the two of them knew that they were going to meet each other here at this time.
In this way, the two became more and more familiar with each other, and the content of their conversations became more and more in-depth. They talked about each other's moods and each other's origins.
He knew that she came from a distinguished family, but in fact she was under a lot of pressure. Her appearance had long disappointed her parents to despair. Now she could only rely on her homework and musical performance to satisfy her parents.
And she also knew that he was the son of a concubine and was kicked out of the house by his father's wife. Now he relied on working to support himself. After his mother died, he was alone and free.
But he knew that in her heart she longed to lose weight, long to get rid of her current appearance and become a normal person. Now she can only live in the eyes of others.
And she also knew that he was actually very lonely. He wandered around every day and met a lot of "little brothers" and "underlings", but he was still lonely.
That day in the atrium, Shen Minghui shared with him the ups and downs of band training. As she talked, she suggested to him that the band would hold a small concert in the school next week and that he should come and participate to help increase its popularity.
"The school wouldn't want me to participate."
"How could that be? Just sit there and listen!"
"Even if I sit there obediently, the school will not think that I am obedient."
"But... didn't you tell me not to care about what others think and just be yourself?"
Zhao Tinghan was silent, and after thinking about it, he found that he was trapped by his own words and could not find any words of defense. Finally, he had to agree to her.
More importantly, he found that he could not refuse her at all - refuse the request of the only girl in this school who did not regard him as a villain and had the courage to talk to him.
Time flies by, and finally it’s next week, when the school’s auditorium is converted into a concert venue. Tonight's performance, Shen MingHui Jiang had a solo, maybe because the teacher didn't choose her as the first principal, and she felt sorry, so she was specially given this opportunity.
Although there are many members who are dissatisfied, and although these members reluctantly admit that Shen Minghui's piano skills are the best in the group, they feel very uncomfortable if they are asked to accept that this fat girl has the opportunity to perform a solo on stage, especially those girls who think that they are a thousand or ten thousand times more beautiful than Shen Minghui.
Shen Minghui didn't care about this. She got this opportunity to go on stage and perform for everyone. It was too late for her to be happy, and she had no time to care about what others were doing.
